premises.text: Students struggle to find qualified, accessible, available private tutors quickly
premises.evidence_span: One out of three students struggle to find a tutor. And it takes, on average, four to five hours to find someone who's qualified, accessible, and available

premises.text: An app lets students pick a course, choose a pre-vetted tutor, and book a session in three steps
premises.evidence_span: connects students to highly qualified private tutors in three simple steps

premises.text: Sessions can be in person or online with notes, whiteboarding, and video built in-house
premises.evidence_span: we build our online tutoring system from scratch with note sharing, whiteboarding, and video functionalities

premises.text: ML-assisted vetting and graph-based matching recommend tutors on proximity, education, and hours
premises.evidence_span: Our machine learning algorithm are helping our HR team to pre-select our candidates

premises.text: Tutors are charged a 20% commission and rewarded with training, internships, and bonuses
premises.evidence_span: We charge our tutors a 20% commission per transaction

premises.text: Schools and universities can be charged a monthly fee for tutoring-activity analytics
premises.evidence_span: charge the institutions, universities, and schools $1,000 per month in exchange for analytics

value.text: Students get qualified private tutors quickly through a peer platform

causal_links.evidence_span: Our business model is quite simple

notes: Hour/student traction counts excluded. Arabic/MENA positioning treated as market scope for the product, not a separate premise. Tutor rewards kept with commission as one tutor-side commercial module; institutional analytics fee split (distinct buyer).
